profile: MediciNova is a biopharmaceutical company developing therapeutics for serious diseases with unmet medical needs, with a commercial focus on the United States. Its development activities center on MN-166 (ibudilast) for neurological and other disorders, including multiple sclerosis and ALS, and MN-001 (tipelukast) for fibrotic and metabolic disorders, including nonalcoholic fatty liver disease and hypertriglyceridemia.
